Clear the cached unit selector

Source: R/refresh_units.R
refresh_units.Rd

Forgets the session cache of unit data used by get_unit() and get_geography(), so the next call fetches fresh data from the API.

Usage

refresh_units()

Value

Invisibly TRUE if a cache was cleared, FALSE otherwise.

Examples

# \donttest{
refresh_units()
get_unit() # refetches from the API
#> # A tibble: 1,830 × 5
